'''''Legacy of the Force: Invincible''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Troy Denning]]. It is the ninth and final volume of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series, and it was first published in hardcover by [[Del Rey]] on [[May 13]], [[2008]]. The story is set in [[41 ABY]], and it features the climactic [[Battle of Uroro Station|duel]] between [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and her fallen brother, [[Darth Caedus]].
